events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles,' but universally known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their revolutionary 'White Album'. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul,' showcasing a new depth in their songwriting.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A true masterpiece that pushed musical boundaries.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On January 8th, we remember the visionary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the Starman. David Bowie would have turned 80 today, forever influencing music, fashion, and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: January 8th marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Tribute
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves, Elvis Presley's music is eternal.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist and Led Zeppelin founder, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock music.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive raspy-voiced rock and pop legend, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: One step beyond! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite Nutty Boy anthem?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home),' celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the soulful Paul Young! His incredible voice defined a generation.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: On January 19th, we honour the indelible legacy of Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly 81st Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, who would have turned 81 today. Her music and spirit shine on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams, get into our cars... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inducted its first class. Who would be in your dream Hall of Fame line-up?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: February 3rd marks the tragic anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died,' when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died.' Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up,' celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: You know the drill! Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the legend, Rick Astley. Never gonna give him up!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: On February 6th, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley, who would have turned 82.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Remembering the legendary Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Iconic singer-songwriter Carole King, a prolific hitmaker and 'Tapestry' artist, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 years since her passing
events.blurb: February 11th marks 15 years since the world tragically lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: 15 years since we said goodbye to Whitney Houston. Her voice, her power, her legacy remains.

events.title: Anniversary of Take That's split (1996)
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the pop world was rocked as Take That announced their split, leading to national heartbreak.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: 28 years ago today, Take That broke millions of hearts by announcing their split. Who remembers where they were when they heard the news?
